title: System technosignatures by scenario
transcriptionMethod: Manual transcription of marked cells from the PDF table, checked against a rendered page and the paper's surrounding prose.
assumptions: Membership means the source table marks the technosignature as present in that scenario; it does not establish detectability by a particular mission.
notes: Every marked or blank scenario cell carries an exact Table 8 row/column locator; blank is not silently translated into a broader absence claim.
